title: Version 1.13.0
body:
Version 1.13.0

June 28th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added brand new ladder schematic!
  • Added brand new Classic Store!
  • Added back the classic ore, and tree
  • The Classic store includes an alternating table of 9 items every 12 hours!

Changes:

  • Increased hotbar limit to 9 (7 prior)",
  • Updated the main menu screen
  • Mike is now riskily standing upon scaffolding, and has changed attitudes

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue where tools would activate when moving the camera on mobile
  • Fixed driving UI showing if the vehicle was despawned whilst driving
  • Fixed glitch that allowed you to collect multiple fireflies at once
